items.question: Will film make my house or office too dark?
items.answer: No. Light, nearly clear films are available that keep your view and natural light while cutting glare and UV.

items.question: Does sunlight through my windows really fade furniture and flooring?
items.answer: Yes. The same rays that fade furnishings, flooring and fabric keep working on a mild day, not only a hot one. Cutting that exposure is one of the main reasons people put film on a west-facing room. Source: The Skin Cancer Foundation.

items.question: Can it help lower cooling bills?
items.answer: It can help. Film turns away part of the sun's heat at the glass, so a sunny room stays more comfortable and your air conditioning does not have to fight the sun as hard. We do not promise a number on your bill, because what you see depends on your home and your glass.

items.question: How does the process work?
items.answer: Call, text or request a time. We come to measure and give you a free quote, walk you through the film options, then book your install date. On that day the work is usually done in a single visit.

items.question: Do you come to my house?
items.answer: Yes. For home and office film and blinds we come to you to measure and install. Vehicles come to the shop.
